check_notes.A1-2: NOT APPLICABLE: Cosmos Hub proposals are deposit-gated, not delegated-power-gated; there is no proposer-voting-power maintenance rule to apply.
check_notes.A1-4: No maximum number of messages per proposal is stated in the live gov params or the Cosmos SDK gov spec; proposals in the window carry one message type each, but multi-message proposals are not bounded by a documented cap.
check_notes.A2-1: No voting delay: once a proposal reaches the 500 ATOM minimum deposit it enters the voting period immediately. The deposit period (up to 14 days) is the only review window, and it can be as short as the time to fund the deposit.
check_notes.A2-4: No vote-differential rule: a proposal passes on >50% yes (excluding abstain) plus 40% quorum. The 33.4% veto threshold is a rejection rule, not a winning-margin rule.
check_notes.A2-6: Top-4 bonded validators hold 37.98% of bonded stake — over the 1/3 Tendermint liveness threshold. Top-1 18.79% (Coinbase01), top-10 56.49%, HHI 0.0578, from the 2026-11-10 bonded-validators snapshot (180 validators).
check_notes.A3-1: No timelock: a passed proposal executes through the chain (upgrade at a scheduled height, or the message executes on passage). There is no mandatory execution delay after the vote closes.
check_notes.A3-2: No grace period: Cosmos Hub governance has no expiry window for passed proposals; the concept does not exist in the gov module.
check_notes.A3-3: NOT APPLICABLE: there is no timelock; execution authority is the gov module account (cosmos10d07y265gmmuvt4z0w9aw880jnsr700j6zn9kn), which only acts on passed proposals.
check_notes.A4-2: Proposal 1058 passed and moved 1,227,121 ATOM recovered after the Neutron exploit to the Neutron recovery multisig — funds the DAO cannot recall at its own discretion. Proposal 1060 similarly routes community-pool USDC through a community multisig.
check_notes.A4-3: Each treasury/community-pool transfer needs its own vote; no standing per-operation bounds or whitelists were found in the live params or the sampled proposals.
check_notes.A5-1: Only the proposal_cancel_ratio parameter (0.5) hints at a cancel path; its semantics were not verified from a primary source. No documented emergency pause power for governance exists.
check_notes.A5-2: Limits on emergency/cancel powers were not verified from a primary source; the cancel parameter exists but its bounds are undocumented in the fetched sources.
check_notes.A5-3: NOT APPLICABLE: no guardian role exists in Cosmos Hub governance.
check_notes.A5-4: NOT APPLICABLE: the veto is a vote option (NoWithVeto), not a council; there is no veto authority with a term to bound.
